abstract: |
  MËSH is a wireless, networked system for music performances and
  installations, and the successor to the wired SPRAWL system. It
  distributes sound generation, control and interaction across compact,
  self-contained nodes that share control data over OSC. This page is the
  companion to the talk: the same material as the slides, with the spoken
  part written out.
